item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 05/Apr/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A band of clouds will cover southern China in the next couple of days. There will be a few showers over the region. Winds are expected to be weak and the visibility will be relatively low over Guangdong midweek next week. It will be rather warm during the day. Under the influence of upper-air disturbances, there will be a few showers over the coast of southern China in the latter part of next week. There may be thunderstorms over inland areas.
